news.title: Ships Face Fuel Delays at China’s Zhoushan on Supply Squeeze

news.title: Russian Crude Exports Boom Blunted by Kremlin’s Diesel Sales Ban
news.summary: Russia shipped the most crude in a month-and-a-half, while a jump in prices propelled the value of those cargoes close to the highest since the start of the invasion of Ukraine in 2022. But the benefits to the Kremlin are being undermined by its ban on overseas diesel sales.

news.title: Old Hulls, New Money: Why the VLCC Market Has Stopped Counting Years
news.summary: For most of shipping history, the valuation equation has been straightforward. A ship leaves the yard, begins ageing and progressively loses value. New steel commands the premium. Older steel trades at a discount.
